## Source:

Binding spec: /work/lanes/skeptic/inputs/mac/drive/wingthing-app-spec.md and /work/lanes/wt-app/PRD.md. Original item/comments: /work/lanes/refine-wingthing/evidence/fleet-pgmx.show.json and .comments.json.

Card: 02/card-0, ordinal #1: 1 · wt claude from a cold start
Source: /work/lanes/wt-e2e/wingthing/evidence/storyboard-source/02-start.html#1
Carrier: f8f9ebd96e1c72336ffd796c8d496ecda0a85619; Linux forge; isolated HOME/WINGTHING_DIR; fixture provider/SSH, real built wt + kernel PTY.

Expected screen: Cold Claude provider output then reattach same ID
Expected observable state: Exactly one main local-only daemon and one parent at current cwd; detach preserves process/policy

Actual outcome across three runs: FAIL, FAIL, FAIL.


## Why

Bryan and the test owner get an honest platform-qualified result instead of weakening provider confinement to turn Linux tests green.

## The one question / capability

Which scoped-parent scenarios are safely supported on this host, and which require native evidence?

## Scope

Repo: ehrlich-b/wingthing. Base: codex/wt-integration-20261011 @ 3a0b7fa8578b9889d9e17a0e5fb3a1ffab9831ca. Branch: codex/refine-fleet-pgmx-20261011; isolated checkout, record exact head/binary. Compose delivered suite 580d4d9 from codex/wt-storyboard-e2e-20261011 via coordinator. Own cmd/wt/storyboard_pty_test.go, storyboardScopedNew_pty_test.go, CARD-TEST-MAP.md and evidence/platform-boundary/. Preserve intentional non-darwin provider-write refusal in internal/localmcp/conversation_broker_policy.go; production policy is read-only. Native lifecycle owner fleet-da75e077d and durable-run owner fleet-v69u retain their gates. The closed suite lane is provenance, not a live prerequisite.

## Non-goals

No duplicate source-DONE implementation, Linux confinement bypass, public release/deploy, account/payment/provider spend or external outreach. Bare wt stays primary; free SSH/LAN/tailnet stay available and automatic Pro offers default OFF. Use disposable fixture sessions and installer transports; actual user/native/physical acceptance remains separately evidenced.

## Acceptance

Reproduce TestStoryboardStartCard0,1,2,5 and TestStoryboardRunsCard1 on the integrated head three times, with explicit test enumeration/execution and SHA/binary/platform/provider identity. On Linux assert the current intentional admission refusal, no admitted parent/work/duplicate daemon, no policy broadening or privileged retry; label the downstream scoped launch/readiness/concurrency/durable-receipt scenario REQUIRED-UNRUN, never PASS from that denial. Preserve runnable routing subtests and their distinct results. Any fixture adaptation uses the existing explicit synthetic route with zero production policy changes; it proves routing only. No skip/no-match may qualify the whole card. On Mac collect real native scoped cold/cwd/local/forge, two parents/one daemon and canceled-waiter-surviving-work receipts; fleet-da75e077d owns native lifecycle and fleet-v69u owns durable run identity/output acceptance. Missing native receipts block full scenario qualification. Retain all expected state obligations from the five merged reports, and independently review the per-platform classification against source and test bodies. Merged source-card obligations (original transcripts retained in evidence/<id>.show.json):

fleet-pi85 (TestStoryboardRunsCard1): Scoped parent agent task receipt for selected forge
Expected observable state: Allowed remote cwd; wing/run/session IDs saved, original idempotency key reconciled; accepted workers survive disconnect

fleet-6w2j (TestStoryboardStartCard5): Two concurrent Claude parent screens
Expected observable state: Two distinct requested parents share one main local-only daemon; canceled readiness waiter cannot kill survivor; detach does not replace daemon

fleet-vws3 (TestStoryboardStartCard2): n prompts selected machine and cwd, attaches scoped Claude parent
Expected observable state: Saved forge route, native parent/MCP registration, exact cwd and durable child receipts; generic route remains distinct

fleet-5ddm (TestStoryboardStartCard1): Explicit --cwd parent output; outside-scope refusal
Expected observable state: Receiving machine stores chosen canonical cwd; no session admitted on denied path

## Review loop

Builder reviews every diff/card expectation against the one question and clear/purposeful/testable/minimal/deduplicated/no-one-shot rubric. Independent gpt-6.1-sol high implementation/evidence review before handoff; security reviewer checks policy, cursor or route authority changes. Fix findings and re-review. Product mocks must pass before UI work; coordinator integrates shared files serially.

## Dependencies

Blocking IDs: fleet-jugv. Tracking parent is not a blocker. Preserve native/physical gates and current active owner; do not create another suite lane.

## V/C

V=9/10; C=6 remaining agent-hours for bounded suite composition, rerun/report classification and independent review; excludes native/physical wait and product fixes. Original 6/1.3 scheduling units retained in evidence.

## Final concurrent evidence

The historical suite owner fleet-czcb completed source delivery at 580d4d9 on codex/wt-storyboard-e2e-20261011 with three 17-PASS/34-FAIL runs on f8f9ebd. This task now owns the remaining integrated suite composition/rerun (no second suite implementation): port those tests by coordinator, enumerate every flow1–6 test and rerun three times at the integrated head. Each card reports screen and state evidence with prerequisite/native/physical qualification separate; zero fixture pass, test skip or successful denial may become full-card acceptance. Preserve existing test expectations and file only deduplicated genuine new integrated failures. 

Merged source-card obligations (original transcripts retained in evidence/<id>.show.json):

fleet-6ev0 (TestStoryboardPhoneCard17): Finishing pairing; Check pairing result for dropped final reply
Expected observable state: Original encrypted success recoverable before deadline; exactly one persisted grant, duplicate confirm idempotent

fleet-hqms (TestStoryboardPhoneCard16): Permission denial Settings/rescan/manual invitation path
Expected observable state: Fallback includes endpoint, public pin and words; no private-key/credential clipboard export

fleet-qh4d (TestStoryboardPhoneCard15): Connected tailnet Free, no relay/account prompt
Expected observable state: Allowed LAN/tailnet endpoints, full pin validation; no Wingthing relay request

fleet-0oli (TestStoryboardPhoneCard14): Explicit notification consent; generic lock-screen attention
Expected observable state: No names/transcript/commands/secrets in push payload; background delivery requires physical-device evidence

fleet-v3b6 (TestStoryboardPhoneCard13): Phone Stop pairing? names exact machine/session; Keep running
Expected observable state: Detach preserves process; confirmed stop receipt targets exact execution, other sessions alive

fleet-0p5v (TestStoryboardPhoneCard12): Phone output/composer and explicit Send; delivery unknown on lost ack
Expected observable state: Wing-bound encrypted input exactly once; reconnect reads, never replays

fleet-8xhy (TestStoryboardPhoneCard11): wt devices revoke receipt and phone Access revoked
Expected observable state: Persist revocation and close active streams before success; forge unaffected; no remote erasure claim

fleet-v2pw (TestStoryboardPhoneCard10): Emoji mismatch Cancel; terminal no access granted and fresh QR
Expected observable state: Both confirmations discarded and invitation burned

fleet-ezc3 (TestStoryboardPhoneCard9): Identity mismatch hard stop with Cancel and no Continue
Expected observable state: Full scanned pin checked before continuation; no grant, pin replacement or fallback

fleet-pet5 (TestStoryboardPhoneCard8): Unreachable machine with free Wi-Fi/tailnet alternative
Expected observable state: No credential sent on failed route; phone no account authority

fleet-yq9i (TestStoryboardPhoneCard7): Expired/used QR refused; Enter creates a fresh QR
Expected observable state: Old invitation cannot grant; fresh secret/ID/deadline; memory-only single use

fleet-ag5w (TestStoryboardPhoneCard6): Independent paired machine list and wt devices registry
Expected observable state: Separate pins/credentials and revocation per wing

fleet-lo13 (TestStoryboardPhoneCard5): Away from home connected through encrypted pinned relay
Expected observable state: LAN then tailnet then entitled registered relay; phone never logs in

fleet-wudw (TestStoryboardPhoneCard4): Wing-bound sessions with status/attention and attach controls
Expected observable state: Device has only sessions/attach/read/input/stop/detach/close; no config or other-wing authority

fleet-5bo6 (TestStoryboardPhoneCard3): Saving this machine securely; private key stays on phone
Expected observable state: P-256 device-only Keychain and reviewed SPAKE2 channel; atomic hashed wing registry

fleet-bmxl (TestStoryboardPhoneCard2): Same four emoji on phone/terminal; both confirmations
Expected observable state: No credential before both approvals; cancellation burns invitation

fleet-mxtz (TestStoryboardPhoneCard1): iPhone camera Scan to pair reads terminal invitation
Expected observable state: Phone contacts exact endpoint/pin, no phone account or copied account token

fleet-cpab (TestStoryboardPhoneCard0): Pair a phone, pinned identity/QR, six words and 5:00 waiting screen
Expected observable state: Invitation uses existing main wing; creation+300s, single use, no second identity

Rebase/compose the suite onto the named integrated source through its active owner before asserting a missing command. Record old versus new SHA/binary hashes and test changes. A phone CLI prerequisite PASS never qualifies the downstream card. Replace the deliberate universal REQUIRED-UNRUN failure with a report that separately records prerequisite result and each downstream REQUIRED-UNRUN gate; do not fabricate iOS screens or remove source assertions. Per-card owner map: invitation/emoji/expiry/final reply fleet-43m7; keys/seven RPC/live revoke fleet-tb2s; direct-route/permission fleet-b3xe; physical scan/read/input/exact Stop/independent wings fleet-57rd; paid relay fleet-awri and actual cellular fleet-q6yh; notification design fleet-2jhq. Complete flow-5 card acceptance remains gated on their receipts; an unknown-command fix is neither physical acceptance nor notification implementation.

## Source:

Source goal: Wingthing whole-app spec and PRD; no direct Bryan quote in this item.

## Why

Bryan and the coordinator see the next useful gate without a sprawling implementation epic.

## The one question / capability

What is the next unmet gate to useful Wingthing work for Bryan and customers?

## Scope

Repo: ehrlich-b/wingthing (https://github.com/ehrlich-b/wingthing). Base: codex/wt-integration-20261011 @ 3a0b7fa8578b9889d9e17a0e5fb3a1ffab9831ca; record actual integrated head after coordinator composes brief11. Branch: codex/refine-fleet-9e8778acfc12-20261011. Work in an isolated checkout; retain existing active lane/assignee/status and coordinate shared files through the integration owner. docs/product/RELEASE-GATES.md and existing child map in integration checkout; track task IDs, source vs native/physical/customer evidence and decisions. Aggregate only; no duplicate implementation or automatic dispatch. First-session/forge precede physical phone/external pilot, then paid cloud, then teams/density.

## Non-goals

No duplicate completed source, public release/deploy/outreach, real billing/provider/account mutation or spending in the local implementation slice. Use temporary state and fixture transports for automated acceptance. Physical/provider/customer acceptance requires separate owner-approved receipts; do not label fixture passes as those gates. Bare wt stays the entrypoint; free local/SSH/LAN/tailnet remain; automatic Pro offers OFF by default.

## Acceptance

Every live child maps to one goal and receipt or exact unmet gate; DONE source never presented as physical/release success. fleet-7zpb bare-wt install/local-only/OFF-default upsells remains explicit unmet gate. Parent stays tracking-only; checklist links existing children and approvals with no duplicate beads.

## Review loop

Builder self-reviews the diff and evidence against the one question, source requirements and failure cases, revising until clear/purposeful/testable/minimal/deduplicated with no one-shot traps. A separate gpt-6.1-sol reviewer checks implementation, evidence and remaining gates before handoff; security/authority changes also require an independent security reviewer. Fix every failed acceptance or review finding and re-review changed scope. Coordinator reviews exact head and retained REQUIRED-UNRUN gates; Bryan owns any stated external decision.

## Dependencies

Blocking IDs: none. Parent hierarchy is tracking, not a prerequisite. Retain existing external/native/approval blockers; conditional work never bypasses them.

## V/C

V=10/10; C=2 agent-hours remaining. Rationale: Bryan and the coordinator see the next useful gate without a sprawling implementation epic. Estimate includes bounded implementation/receipt analysis, self-review and independent review; human wait time excluded. Old C used mixed board/engineer-day units and is preserved in the audit, not treated as hours.

Integration base reconciliation: 3a0b7fa8578b9889d9e17a0e5fb3a1ffab9831ca is a verified descendant of the independently reviewed 0a2b2d26b4fcf50cf8ead4ffce0fa4e6e50071ad. The new commit keeps Mac confinement required and corrects Linux terminal fixture assertions; this pin does not claim native acceptance. Preserve the reviewed mini-PRD and additive lead gates in future updates; source DONE verdicts are unchanged.

## Resumed refinement reconciliation

Closed fleet-7zpb delivered blocked artifacts only, with no product implementation. Live fleet-kxez now owns its undelivered first-run/local-only/OFF-default offer product scope; require its actual acceptance before this dependent gate. Existing closed dependency is historical, not proof of completion.

## Why

Bryan and the coordinator see the next useful gate without a sprawling implementation epic.

## The one question / capability

What is the next unmet gate to useful Wingthing work for Bryan and customers?

## Scope

Repo: ehrlich-b/wingthing (https://github.com/ehrlich-b/wingthing). Base: codex/wt-integration-20261011 @ 3a0b7fa8578b9889d9e17a0e5fb3a1ffab9831ca; record actual integrated head after coordinator composes brief11. Branch: codex/refine-fleet-9e8778acfc12-20261011. Work in an isolated checkout; retain existing active lane/assignee/status and coordinate shared files through the integration owner. docs/product/RELEASE-GATES.md and existing child map in integration checkout; track task IDs, source vs native/physical/customer evidence and decisions. Aggregate only; no duplicate implementation or automatic dispatch. First-session/forge precede physical phone/external pilot, then paid cloud, then teams/density.

## Non-goals

No duplicate completed source, public release/deploy/outreach, real billing/provider/account mutation or spending in the local implementation slice. Use temporary state and fixture transports for automated acceptance. Physical/provider/customer acceptance requires separate owner-approved receipts; do not label fixture passes as those gates. Bare wt stays the entrypoint; free local/SSH/LAN/tailnet remain; automatic Pro offers OFF by default.

## Acceptance

Every live child maps to one goal and receipt or exact unmet gate; DONE source never presented as physical/release success. fleet-7zpb bare-wt install/local-only/OFF-default upsells remains explicit unmet gate. Parent stays tracking-only; checklist links existing children and approvals with no duplicate beads.

## Review loop

Builder self-reviews the diff and evidence against the one question, source requirements and failure cases, revising until clear/purposeful/testable/minimal/deduplicated with no one-shot traps. A separate gpt-6.1-sol reviewer checks implementation, evidence and remaining gates before handoff; security/authority changes also require an independent security reviewer. Fix every failed acceptance or review finding and re-review changed scope. Coordinator reviews exact head and retained REQUIRED-UNRUN gates; Bryan owns any stated external decision.

## Dependencies

Blocking IDs: none. Parent hierarchy is tracking, not a prerequisite. Retain existing external/native/approval blockers; conditional work never bypasses them.

## V/C

V=10/10; C=2 agent-hours remaining. Rationale: Bryan and the coordinator see the next useful gate without a sprawling implementation epic. Estimate includes bounded implementation/receipt analysis, self-review and independent review; human wait time excluded. Old C used mixed board/engineer-day units and is preserved in the audit, not treated as hours.

The new commit keeps Mac confinement required and corrects Linux terminal fixture assertions; this pin does not claim native acceptance. Preserve the reviewed mini-PRD and additive lead gates in future updates; source DONE verdicts are unchanged.

Closed fleet-7zpb delivered blocked artifacts only, with no product implementation. Live fleet-kxez now owns its undelivered first-run/local-only/OFF-default offer product scope; require its actual acceptance before this dependent gate. title: Wingthing: retain exact policy and provider cause in launch denial
description:
## Source:

Binding spec: /work/lanes/skeptic/inputs/mac/drive/wingthing-app-spec.md and /work/lanes/wt-app/PRD.md. Original item/comments: /work/lanes/refine-wingthing/evidence/fleet-x4yv.show.json and .comments.json.

Card: 02/card-4, ordinal #5: Provider missing, policy denied, or daemon not ready
Source: /work/lanes/wt-e2e/wingthing/evidence/storyboard-source/02-start.html#5
Carrier: f8f9ebd96e1c72336ffd796c8d496ecda0a85619; Linux forge; isolated HOME/WINGTHING_DIR; fixture provider/SSH, real built wt + kernel PTY.

Expected screen: Launch failure phase, named policy, actionable next step and admitted-ID recovery
Expected observable state: Policy/provider preparation and readiness are distinct; no privileged fallback, secret exposure or duplicate admission

Actual outcome across three runs: FAIL, FAIL, FAIL.


## Why

Bryan sees actionable phase and policy evidence for the actual refusal without retrying with broader authority.

## The one question / capability

Can Bryan tell why this launch was refused and what safe next step exists?

## Scope

Repo: ehrlich-b/wingthing. Base: codex/wt-integration-20261011 @ 3a0b7fa8578b9889d9e17a0e5fb3a1ffab9831ca. Branch: codex/refine-fleet-x4yv-20261011; isolated checkout, record actual head and binary hash. cmd/wt/claude_diagnostics.go, internal/control/errors.go and internal/localmcp/conversation_broker.go denial propagation, plus focused diagnostics tests; integrate TestStoryboardStartCard4 and TestStoryboardRunsCard5 from the active test lane. Fix only the newly observed loss of evidence in the Linux refusal path; WT-14 source remains DONE.

## Non-goals

No duplicate source-DONE implementation, Linux confinement bypass, public release/deploy, account/payment/provider spend or external outreach. Bare wt stays primary; free SSH/LAN/tailnet stay available and automatic Pro offers default OFF. Use disposable fixture sessions and installer transports; actual user/native/physical acceptance remains separately evidenced.

## Acceptance

Against integrated source, reproduce both named card tests three times and enumerate each first. An unsupported Linux provider-write model refusal must carry its exact platform cause, actual selected policy provenance and admission phase rather than only generic "Policy: unavailable". Truly unavailable policy/request fields remain explicitly unknown; never invent a captured request or readiness. Fixtures independently cover provider missing/toolchain mismatch, policy denial, native readiness, transport failure and admitted-ID recovery; next action uses the original identity and never silently retries/broadens/replaces an unready daemon. Inspect both terminal and dashboard output for bounded diagnostics and no QR/credential/prompt/raw argv/full-path disclosure. go test -race ./cmd/wt ./internal/control ./internal/localmcp executes focused cases; vet/full suite compared to baseline, no new failures. Linux refusal diagnostics may PASS while downstream native launch is REQUIRED-UNRUN; Mac gates remain separate. Merged source-card obligations (original transcripts retained in evidence/<id>.show.json):

fleet-9h8k (TestStoryboardRunsCard5): Policy/toolchain/provider-readiness failure phase/source/action
Expected observable state: Denials authoritative; launch receipts retained; no policy broadening, secret exposure or duplicate retry
 MOCKS-FIRST: proposed happy/failure screenshots must receive builder self-review and separate product-review PASS against each named view question before UI implementation; revise and re-review failed mocks, then review actual screenshots/transcripts after build.

## UI contract / MOCKS-FIRST gate

User: Bryan sees actionable phase and policy evidence for the actual refusal without retrying with broader authority. One question per view: Launch failure: which phase and selected policy caused this refusal, and what can I safely do next? Reference: /work/lanes/wt-app/storyboard (flow matching source card), existing dense keyboard navigator and docs/pairing/STORYBOARD.html. Before UI build, capture happy/failure mock screens at narrow/wide sizes with readable focus/status, then self-review and obtain independent product-review PASS. Revise failures before building; review actual screenshots/transcripts again after build.

## Review loop

Builder reviews every diff/card expectation against the one question and clear/purposeful/testable/minimal/deduplicated/no-one-shot rubric. Independent gpt-6.1-sol high implementation/evidence review before handoff; security reviewer checks policy, cursor or route authority changes. Fix findings and re-review. Product mocks must pass before UI work; coordinator integrates shared files serially.

## Dependencies

Blocking IDs: fleet-jugv. Tracking parent is not a blocker. Preserve native/physical gates and current active owner; do not create another suite lane.

## V/C

V=9/10; C=4 remaining agent-hours including implementation/qualification and review, excluding human wait. Rationale: Bryan sees actionable phase and policy evidence for the actual refusal without retrying with broader authority. Original V/C=6/1.3 uses board scheduling units, retained in evidence rather than compared as hours.
acceptance_criteria:
Against integrated source, reproduce both named card tests three times and enumerate each first. An unsupported Linux provider-write model refusal must carry its exact platform cause, actual selected policy provenance and admission phase rather than only generic "Policy: unavailable". Truly unavailable policy/request fields remain explicitly unknown; never invent a captured request or readiness. Fixtures independently cover provider missing/toolchain mismatch, policy denial, native readiness, transport failure and admitted-ID recovery; next action uses the original identity and never silently retries/broadens/replaces an unready daemon. Inspect both terminal and dashboard output for bounded diagnostics and no QR/credential/prompt/raw argv/full-path disclosure. go test -race ./cmd/wt ./internal/control ./internal/localmcp executes focused cases; vet/full suite compared to baseline, no new failures. Linux refusal diagnostics may PASS while downstream native launch is REQUIRED-UNRUN; Mac gates remain separate. Merged source-card obligations (original transcripts retained in evidence/<id>.show.json):

fleet-9h8k (TestStoryboardRunsCard5): Policy/toolchain/provider-readiness failure phase/source/action
Expected observable state: Denials authoritative; launch receipts retained; no policy broadening, secret exposure or duplicate retry MOCKS-FIRST: proposed happy/failure screenshots must receive builder self-review and separate product-review PASS against each named view question before UI implementation; revise and re-review failed mocks, then review actual screenshots/transcripts after build.

What is the next unmet gate to useful Wingthing work for Bryan and customers?

## Scope

Work in an isolated checkout; retain existing active lane/assignee/status and coordinate shared files through the integration owner. docs/product/RELEASE-GATES.md and existing child map in integration checkout; track task IDs, source vs native/physical/customer evidence and decisions. Aggregate only; no duplicate implementation or automatic dispatch. First-session/forge precede physical phone/external pilot, then paid cloud, then teams/density.

## Non-goals

No duplicate completed source, public release/deploy/outreach, real billing/provider/account mutation or spending in the local implementation slice. Use temporary state and fixture transports for automated acceptance. Physical/provider/customer acceptance requires separate owner-approved receipts; do not label fixture passes as those gates. Bare wt stays the entrypoint; free local/SSH/LAN/tailnet remain; automatic Pro offers OFF by default.

Every live child maps to one goal and receipt or exact unmet gate; DONE source never presented as physical/release success. fleet-7zpb bare-wt install/local-only/OFF-default upsells remains explicit unmet gate. Parent stays tracking-only; checklist links existing children and approvals with no duplicate beads.

## Review loop

Builder self-reviews the diff and evidence against the one question, source requirements and failure cases, revising until clear/purposeful/testable/minimal/deduplicated with no one-shot traps. A separate gpt-6.1-sol reviewer checks implementation, evidence and remaining gates before handoff; security/authority changes also require an independent security reviewer. Fix every failed acceptance or review finding and re-review changed scope. Coordinator reviews exact head and retained REQUIRED-UNRUN gates; Bryan owns any stated external decision.

## Dependencies

Blocking IDs: none. Parent hierarchy is tracking, not a prerequisite. Retain existing external/native/approval blockers; conditional work never bypasses them.

V=10/10; C=2 agent-hours remaining. Rationale: Bryan and the coordinator see the next useful gate without a sprawling implementation epic. Old C used mixed board/engineer-day units and is preserved in the audit, not treated as hours.
